name: College Now (MDUSD and Diablo Valley College)
org: Mt. Diablo Unified School District and Diablo Valley College
city: Pleasant Hill, CA (at Diablo Valley College)
what_you_do: Spend your junior and senior years on a college campus. You take three or four high school classes taught by Mt. Diablo teachers. You take the rest of your classes at DVC and earn high school and college credit.
who_can_apply: Mt. Diablo Unified students who are interested and eligible. In 2027-2028 class capacity will be 60 juniors and 60 seniors. Talk to your high school counselor about the rules.
pay_detail: Cost is not stated on the College Now page. DVC says its dual enrollment classes are free.
deadline_text: Applications for 2027-2028 are open and due Feb 15, 2027. No late applications. Interviews are in spring 2027.
how_to_apply: Talk to your high school counselor. Then fill out the College Now student application on the program page. A recommendation form is also on the page. Go to the parent night if you can.
notes: The program started in fall 2016. Parent nights are Feb 3, 2027 at Willow Creek Center and Feb 4, 2027 at the MDHS Library, 6 to 7:30 p.m. Staff phone on the page: 925-969-2512. The DVC page also lists a related program called Diamante Scholars for Mt. Diablo seniors.
